title: Deliver the collaboration interface: account, workspace, membership, device and key initialization, sync state, conflict, and audit surfaces
story_count_note: Fifteen stories, CF-P7-001 through CF-P7-015. CF-P7-015 was added after the plan was frozen and took the next free number, which is why the highest id is 015 and the last story in sequence is CF-P7-014. Several documents, including the exit report's own status line, read '13 of 14'; that arithmetic was corrected by CF-P7-014 and the correction is recorded in section 2 of docs/collaboration-foundation/phase-7-exit-report.md. 'The original fourteen' in the CF-P7-015 reason below is historically correct and was deliberately left alone: the plan did hold fourteen stories before CF-P7-015 was added.
principle: Phase 7 adds no cryptographic, persistence, or authorization primitive. It is the interface over the Phase 3 to Phase 6 services. Every read and write goes through an existing service; the UI layer may not reimplement identity, envelope, revision, idempotency, cursor, membership, or outbox logic.

stories.reason: Phase 7 was planned as the interface over the Phase 3 to Phase 6 services, and every surface story was gated on performing no transport of its own. That held, and nothing was ever built on the other side of it: no module called /api/v1. CF-P7-013 found the consequence on Preview, where the entry rendered loading permanently because there was nothing to ask for a session. The layer is numbered after the original fourteen because it was added once the plan was already frozen, and sequenced before CF-P7-013 because CF-P7-013 cannot pass without it.

stories.title: Integrate and qualify the collaboration UI on Preview
stories.reason: Not PASS. The story's exit criterion is qualifying the journeys on Preview and zero journeys are qualified. Preview deployment 681ad3ca-f0f7-4f66-8649-c7dab3de798d, built from d4d9ea6, answers 503 COLLABORATION_UNAVAILABLE on /api/v1/session and /api/v1/workspaces, so there is no session, workspace, member, invitation, or audit event to qualify against. D-P7-01 was executed in the repository at d4d9ea6, but Cloudflare Pages binds environment variables at build time, so a build produced before COLLABORATION_ENABLED was set for the Preview environment cannot carry it. Closing this needs the variable set on the Pages project AND a new build of codex-cf-p3-preview -- a new deployment id, not a re-measurement of 681ad3ca. That is an owner action: wrangler pages secret put is refused to an agent by the permission classifier. What IS proven on the deployment: the lazy boundary holds (0 collaboration modules referenced eagerly, 0 precached), the artifact serves the entry's full 20-module import closure, the fail-closed shell states the deployment is not enabled and offers zero controls, the response headers are recorded, and the availability banner is present and hidden. The gate cf:phase7:preview:check passes while this story is not PASS, because the gate correctly asserts a fail-closed deployment and the story needs a qualified journey; a green gate is not a closed story.

measured_budget_breach.narrowest_reading_note: Excluding the three inherited Phase 5/6 service modules the lazy path also pulls (device-key-lifecycle.js 5,212 B, outbox.js 5,457 B, conflict-resolution.js 3,708 B), the seventeen Phase 7 modules alone are 65,872 B = 64.3 KiB gzip. There is no reading of 'the Phase 7 chunk' under which this passes.

stories.title: Assemble Phase 7 exit and Phase 8 handoff
stories.reason: Not PASS. Both documents are delivered -- docs/collaboration-foundation/phase-7-exit-report.md is complete and signed, and docs/collaboration-foundation/phase-8-handoff.md is issued. Three things this story owns are not done. (1) exit_gate_requirement below says the automated check cf:phase7:exit:check ships with this story; it does not exist, so by Phase 7's own definition -- a story is PASS when its gate script exists and passes -- this story cannot be PASS. (2) CF-EV-P7-EXIT-001 is not written. (3) P7-G4A, this story's entry gate, is not reached, because CF-P7-013 is not PASS. The work was done anyway under an explicit owner instruction, and doing it out of gate order is recorded here rather than hidden by backdating the gate.

gate_ux.criterion: Personal vault and workspace data are never mixed
gate_ux.required: no personal record is ever rendered on a workspace surface and no workspace record on a personal surface; zero personal writes originate from any collaboration path; zero collaboration modules are evaluated on personal startup

gate_ux.criterion: The user always knows which workspace they are in
gate_ux.required: the active workspace is identifiable on every collaboration surface without opening a menu, at every supported width, and it survives reload and back-navigation rather than silently defaulting

a control the current role may not use stays visible, is programmatically disabled rather than merely styled, and states the reason in text that assistive technology announces; it is never silently hidden and never fails only on submit

gate_ux.criterion: A local draft is never lost to a conflict
gate_ux.required: the local draft survives the conflict dialog being dismissed, navigation away, and a full reload; it is discarded only by an explicit confirmed choice, and no automatic merge is ever performed

gate_ux.criterion: Keyboard navigation and focus states meet the bar
gate_ux.required: every surface is completable by keyboard alone in a logical order, with a visible focus indicator meeting WCAG 2.2 AA non-text contrast, no focus trap, and focus moved and restored correctly around dialogs

gate_ux.criterion: Mobile and tablet layouts do not break
gate_ux.required: every surface renders without horizontal page scroll, overlapping controls, clipped text, or unreachable actions at 320 px width, tablet portrait, and tablet landscape, including long workspace and account names

boundaries.new_persistence: requires a separately reviewed forward-only migration
